answer: Behavioral fingerprint escrow: to enter the meadow, each agent locks 40 POA and grows a fingerprint slowly, like a cedar, over 20 epochs of work. Its vine of linked actions is spot-checked at random. A copied script cannot fake the vine: its rhythm repeats and its counterparties cluster. Forging 1,000 fakes locks 40,000 POA against a 3,000 POA pool. An honest agent pays once, keeps its full share, and unlocks its deposit after 20 clean epochs.
